meta.title: Tenant Directory & Provisioning
meta.functional_baseline: Platform Admin — Tenant Establishment Casework, Portfolio & Lifecycle Governance
meta.lifecycle: Draft Request → Validation Pending → Provisioning → Verification → Ready for Activation → Active → Suspended → Decommission Pending → Decommissioning → Decommissioned → Archived

governance.authority: Admin Tenant & Organization Provisioning Authority v1
governance.concurrency_authority: EDX Version & Optimistic Concurrency Authority v1.0
governance.audit_evidence_authority: EDX Canonical Audit & Evidence Authority v1
governance.impact_analysis_authority: EDX Pre-Action Impact Analysis Authority v1.0
governance.scope_policy: Readiness evidence must match tenantId, institution scope and environment. Global authority state never satisfies another tenant's readiness.
governance.archive_policy: Tenant records are archived/tombstoned after governed decommission; tenant identity remains available for lifecycle history and evidence.
governance.change_management_policy: Environment, institution classification, entitlement package, data residency, hosting region, identity/SSO, and domain changes are governed configuration requests and are not ordinary tenant-detail edits.
governance.editable_metadata_policy: Direct tenant-detail edits are limited to display/legal name, primary contact, governed owners, timezone, and notes; a change reason is required.
governance.organization_scope_policy: Platform Admin establishes and validates the initial organization boundary and reviews provider-impacting structural exceptions. Routine post-activation organization maintenance is owned by Tenant Admin within delegated authority.
governance.organization_change_policy: Platform Admin establishes initial organization boundaries before activation and governs escalated provider-impacting structural changes. Routine post-activation organization maintenance remains with Tenant Admin.
governance.downstream_scope_contract: Downstream workflows consume governed tenant and organization scope established through the approved organization boundary.
governance.role_boundary: Platform Admin establishes tenant boundaries, authorizes provisioning and lifecycle transitions, reviews specialist fulfilment evidence, validates initial organization scope, and governs provider-impacting structural exceptions. Platform Operations and other specialists execute fulfilment. Tenant Admin owns routine post-activation organization, identity, user, connector, domain and tenant-operational administration.
governance.domain_governance_policy: Platform Admin governs initial domain requirements and provider-impacting domain exceptions. Routine post-activation domain administration and ownership verification remain with Tenant Admin.
governance.provisioning_oversight_policy: Platform Admin authorizes specialist provisioning, reviews returned progress and exception evidence, verifies readiness, and authorizes activation. Platform Operations executes provisioning steps, retries, remediation and technical fulfilment; Platform Admin does not advance technical job steps.
governance.post_activation_organization_policy: After tenant activation, routine organization creation, hierarchy maintenance, identifiers, delegated administration, reporting participation and organization metadata are Tenant Admin-owned. Platform Admin receives only escalated provider-impacting structural requests for governance review.
governance.decommission_fulfilment_policy: Platform Admin approves governed decommission after prerequisites are satisfied and reviews specialist fulfilment evidence. Platform Operations and domain specialists execute shutdown, revocation, archive/disposition and technical decommission steps.
governance.establishment_policy: Provider establishment decisions use a scoped case, maker-checker authority, rationale, evidence, blocking prerequisite assessment, owner-assigned conditions, case-preserving resubmission, independent condition closure, and separate authorization of specialist fulfilment. Neither approval nor verification directly activates a tenant.

meta.mockup_scope: Customer-facing provider establishment portfolio: intake, independent decisions, returned case continuity, conditions, owner evidence receipt, independent closure and specialist provisioning handoff. Tenant activation and technical execution remain separate.

authority.domain_governance_policy: Platform Admin reviews provider-level domain evidence only for initial activation readiness or provider-impacting exceptions. Routine post-activation domain ownership verification and administration remain Tenant Admin / identity-specialist owned.
authority.post_activation_organization_policy: After activation, organization hierarchy, identifiers, delegated administration, reporting participation and routine descriptive metadata are Tenant Admin-owned and read-only to Platform Admin. Platform Admin reviews only provider-impacting structural exceptions.
authority.commercial_readiness_policy: Production tenant activation requires an applicable commercial/agreement reference and readiness status. Platform Admin reviews readiness status; billing/accounting execution remains with the commercial operations function.
authority.suspension_policy: Platform Admin authorizes suspension/resume based on business reason, effective timing, affected-service impact and resume prerequisites. Technical enforcement remains specialist-owned.

environment_guidance.Production: Customer-facing production tenant. Activation requires governed readiness and approval.
environment_guidance.Staging: Pre-production validation tenant. Production data should be restricted to approved test scenarios.
environment_guidance.Development: Engineering/development tenant. Not intended for customer production processing.
environment_guidance.Sandbox: Non-production evaluation tenant. Production activation requires a separate governed lifecycle.

hierarchy_guidance.K-12: State / SEA → LEA / District or Charter Network → School → Program
hierarchy_guidance.Higher Education: University System → University / Community College → Campus → College / School → Department → Program
hierarchy_guidance.P-20W / Cross-Sector: Statewide Exchange → participating SEA / Higher Education Agency / Workforce Agency / LEA / institution / partner. Participation relationships do not imply ownership.
